messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, giving you at least two consecutive days off (including the weekend).

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Jan 1–2 (Sunday–Monday) |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | Feb 20–21 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | May 22–23 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Saturday–Monday) |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 4–5 (Monday–Tuesday) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 9–10 (Monday–Tuesday) |

> **Notes**  
> * Family Day is observed only in certain provinces (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario).  
> * Some provinces have additional provincial holidays that may also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.).  
> * The table above lists the federal holidays that create long weekends across the country.

Feel free to integrate this list into your holiday‑planning app! If you need provincial‑specific long weekends or a more detailed calendar, let me know.
